thesis: VERX is in a confirmed uptrend, above its SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200, with strong 63-day relative strength, and it gapped up on earnings on roughly 3x normal volume. The stock has held the upper part of the gap for two sessions on average volume, which looks like digestion rather than distribution. Fundamentals are medium quality: revenue grows steadily, operating margin and free cash flow are positive, dilution risk is low, and valuation is fair. The setup is a pullback entry, not a chase, because RSI is extended. Reward/risk is only acceptable and the regime is risk-off, so this is a modest, patient long that depends on a dip into the entry zone. The news feed was unavailable, so there is no news evidence either way.
